dry_run.description: Validate the committed manifest and migration bytes without credentials

verify_terminal_state.description: Verify the exact terminal database state without replaying migration SQL

provider_receipt.description: Canonical provider receipt JSON bound to the provider-owned G016 migration

validate.if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.repository == 'twoimo/tzudong' && github.event.repository.full_name == 'twoimo/tzudong' && github.event.repository.default_branch == 'main' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.ref_name == 'main'

steps.name: Verify canonical detached checkout
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch"
test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = "$CANONICAL_REPOSITORY"
test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/$PROTECTED_DEFAULT_BRANCH"
test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "$PROTECTED_DEFAULT_BRANCH"
test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$(git show -s --format=%H HEAD)"
test -z "$(git symbolic-ref --quiet HEAD || true)"
[[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
printf 'sha=%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Validate reviewed manifest without production credentials
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
actual_manifest_sha256="$(sha256sum .github/supabase-migration-release-manifest.v1.json)"
actual_manifest_sha256="${actual_manifest_sha256%% *}"
test "$actual_manifest_sha256" = "$RELEASE_MIGRATION_MANIFEST_SHA256"
node apps/web/scripts/apply-supabase-migration.mjs \
  --migration-id "$MIGRATION_ID" \
  --dry-run \
  --json
printf 'migration_id=%s\n' "$MIGRATION_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
printf 'manifest_sha256=%s\n' "$actual_manifest_sha256" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
printf 'expected_manifest_sha256=%s\n' "$RELEASE_MIGRATION_MANIFEST_SHA256" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

apply.if:
needs.validate.result == 'success' && github.event.inputs.dry_run != 'true' && needs.validate.outputs.validated_sha == github.sha && needs.validate.outputs.manifest_sha256 == needs.validate.outputs.expected_manifest_sha256 && github.repository == 'twoimo/tzudong' && github.event.repository.full_name == 'twoimo/tzudong' && github.event.repository.default_branch == 'main' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.ref_name == 'main' && (vars.G037_WRITE_FREEZE != 'active' ||
 contains(fromJSON('["g016_privacy_audit_owner_policy","g016_onboarding_confirmation_freshness"]'), needs.validate.outputs.migration_id)) &&
(!contains(fromJSON('["g016_privacy_audit_owner_policy","g016_onboarding_confirmation_freshness"]'), needs.validate.outputs.migration_id) ||
 github.event.inputs.verify_terminal_state == 'true')

steps.name: Recheck canonical detached checkout and bound release manifest
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch"
test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = "$CANONICAL_REPOSITORY"
test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/$PROTECTED_DEFAULT_BRANCH"
test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "$PROTECTED_DEFAULT_BRANCH"
test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "${{ needs.validate.outputs.validated_sha }}"
test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$(git show -s --format=%H HEAD)"
test -z "$(git symbolic-ref --quiet HEAD || true)"
[[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
actual_manifest_sha256="$(sha256sum .github/supabase-migration-release-manifest.v1.json)"
actual_manifest_sha256="${actual_manifest_sha256%% *}"
test "$actual_manifest_sha256" = "$RELEASE_MIGRATION_MANIFEST_SHA256"
test "$actual_manifest_sha256" = "${{ needs.validate.outputs.manifest_sha256 }}"

steps.name: Install PostgreSQL client for migration apply or terminal verification
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y postgresql-client

steps.name: Apply reviewed migration or verify provider-applied terminal state
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
args=(--migration-id "$MIGRATION_ID" --json)
if [ "$VERIFY_TERMINAL_STATE" = "true" ]; then
  args+=(--verify-terminal-state)
  args+=(--provider-receipt "$PROVIDER_RECEIPT")
fi
node apps/web/scripts/apply-supabase-migration.mjs "${args[@]}"
